arcana_revealed_0: The card that can be everything is, in a sense, nothing. Fascinating.
The Fool arrives. I wonder who else here is playing a part.
arcana_revealed_1: To guess correctly is merely to observe carefully. Or so I am told.
The Magician asks what you cannot see. I ask what you think you can.
arcana_revealed_2: Something hidden becomes unhidden. Does it change what was already true?
The Priestess opens a door. What exits may not be what you expected to see.
arcana_revealed_3: The best of what you have. One wonders what that actually is, for some of us.
Keep the good, release the burden. Easier said, as always.
arcana_revealed_4: Authority reasserts itself. Whether that is justice is a separate question.
The King reclaims precedence. How institutional.
arcana_revealed_5: The Hierophant prefers the familiar. I wonder what he is afraid of.
Cancelled. And yet here we all still are, which is its own kind of revelation.
arcana_revealed_6: Four instead of five. The one left behind always knows something the others don't.
Choose four. The unchosen card watches from outside the hand.
arcana_revealed_7: What we release travels to places we may not want it to go.
The Chariot asks for passage. The toll is paid in cards.
arcana_revealed_8: The least becomes the most. I find this arrangement... familiar.
Strength through inversion. The lowly card now stands tallest. Interesting topology.
arcana_revealed_9: One more card. One more thing to be uncertain about. Delightful.
The Hermit extends the search. What are we looking for, exactly?
arcana_revealed_10: Fortune reminds us that what we held was borrowed all along.
The Wheel turns. All those careful plans. How temporary.
arcana_revealed_11: Justice asks that your bet reflect your hand. A revealing constraint, is it not?
Honest stakes. One wonders what that looks like for the habitually theatrical.
arcana_revealed_12: The Hanged Man suggests that suspension has its own kind of clarity.
Three cards gone. Perhaps the ones that leave us were already finished here.
arcana_revealed_13: Death brings clarity. No more distractions. No more beautiful exceptions.
The ordinary game, revealed beneath all the theatre. Somewhat disappointing. Somewhat not.
arcana_revealed_14: Exchange implies that both parties believe they are improving. Often only one is correct.
The swap. I am always curious what someone thinks is a fair trade.
arcana_revealed_15: All or nothing. The Devil simplifies by removing the middle entirely.
There is a kind of honesty in extremes. It eliminates nuance, which some find refreshing.
arcana_revealed_16: The Tower falls equally on all of us. That is the closest thing to fairness I have seen tonight.
arcana_revealed_17: To reach for the new or trust what you hold. The Star leaves the philosophy to you.
Hope as mechanism. One wonders if the Star knows what it is offering.
arcana_revealed_18: The Moon reveals by concealing. Or conceals by revealing. I can never quite tell.
A hidden card. Something that exists without being seen. I understand the appeal.
arcana_revealed_19: The Sun rewards the winner as if winning were not already sufficient.
Abundance for the victor. Fortune has opinions about who deserves abundance.
arcana_revealed_20: Judgement calls back those who thought they were finished. The game, it seems, disagrees.
Return from elimination. One wonders if Judgement has read the room.
arcana_revealed_21: The World doubles the reward. One hopes we all appreciate the weight of that.
Double the pot. The World offers much, but the World also expects something in return.
player_won_round: A win for you. And yet I find myself unsurprised, which surprises me.
Well played. Or well fortuned. The distinction matters less than the result.
ai_won_round: And so it falls to me. I had a feeling.
Interesting. The cards agreed with me this round.
player_folded: You step back. The space you leave is already being filled.
A fold. Something about the hand did not suit you. Or something about the room.
